probe_error.detail: unhandled errors in a TaskGroup (1 sub-exception)

interpretation: A distinct-process, same-generation sampler recorded Q-up (q_down=false) repeatedly after recovery VK_Q key-up SendInput returned and before the held callback returned. This supports a bounded observed state-release interval for this diagnostic window. The callback lasted 1490.357 ms despite the planned 700 ms hold, but R35 recorded only a few public status polls, so the frozen 21-poll R29 strict gate was not satisfied. The sampler ended with unknown/stale-target after fixture teardown. The hook trace has no second distinct Q-up callback. The fixture click/save oracle matched at save time before cancellation, but a later Q character event occurred; this is not post-cancel task success. No strict gate PASS, broad reliability claim, or runtime task_success is justified.
